`final class VideoNativesException`<br/>
**Extends:** `RuntimeException`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.video` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VideoNativesException.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/video/VideoNativesException.java)

The FFmpeg natives that videos need cannot be installed on this machine.

## Description

A video whose natives fail to install fails with this exception as its error; the message names the cause and the fix.
